Implementation review requires an explicit structural revision while preserving all accepted business requirements, the public query input, at-most-ten product limit, actual document write with its output reference, and unconditional browser cleanup. Do not remove existing business work.
The proposed read/extraction composition is not ready for approval: it ignores every authoritative truncation flag, uses guessed product selectors, and uses interpret for observed product-field extraction. Compilation does not prove complete observations. Use inspected producer contracts: bounded observation manifests and existing loops must consume every listed page before navigation/click invalidates its snapshot, with requires guards rejecting captureTruncated or manifestTruncated; page delivery completeness remains tied to that manifest. A bounded targeted HTML/text read is valid only with a guard rejecting truncation and with any selector derived from an actual observation. Missing or incomplete data must not become an empty successful result. Do not assume site-specific selectors or invent product URLs.
Keep this composition simple: retain full source observations; project only necessary typed record fields for the consumer. Use explicit extract transforms for source-grounded JSON/text/HTML-to-business-field extraction, declaring only needed result fields. When independent source/target arrays align one-to-one, leave runtime item processing to extraction or select existing each explicitly when ambiguous; never send an entire raw collection into a global interpret task merely to copy or extract fields. Choose complete bounded record items, not giant page snapshots. Keep only genuine decisions/selection/synthesis as interpret on compact business observations; no duplicate raw collection inputs. Extraction cannot invent status labels or metadata: use observed values, nullable missing fields and explicit business constants outside extraction where needed. No implicit filtering, sorting or flattening in one-to-one extraction.
Preserve conditional acceptance of an actually observed authorized cookie control and a fresh complete observation afterward, actual per-product visits before extraction, document writing and cleanup. A CAPTCHA or impossible completeness remains an explicit failure/limitation. Preserve valid scope exports and references. No new permissions, caller inputs, limits, runtime mechanics or scenario-specific production rules.
